name: What are the common pitfalls to avoid in a Florida 1031 Exchange?

mainEntity.name: What are the common pitfalls to avoid in a Florida 1031 Exchange?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common pitfalls in a 1031 Exchange include missing the 45-day identification or 180-day closing deadlines, failing to use a Qualified Intermediary, identifying non-like-kind property, or not reinvesting all proceeds into a property of equal or greater value. Another issue is attempting to exchange a personal residence or property held for quick resale. A key preparation step is to meticulously plan your exchange and work with experienced professionals early in the process, especially when navigating the diverse real estate markets across Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, and Orange Counties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid missing deadlines, improper property identification, not using a Qualified Intermediary, or insufficient reinvestment in a 1031 Exchange.
